t: How I ran the length of every street in Pittsburgh: PAC TOM

q.x: HN-favourite Tom7 made a great video about running every street in his native Pittsburgh and tracking it. [link]

desc: This video elaborates my project to run the length of every street in the city of Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania. It's called "Pac Tom" because it's like Pac Man eating dots, except with Tom (me) instead of Man. Like Pac Man, there's no time limit, which is good because it took me 16 years! Ultimately I ran 3661 miles in 269 jaunts. It's not a programming video, but you could still think of it as a sort
